prettier + eslint across every workspace package; whole-repo because the workspace has no per-package lint config worth scoping; serial (default 'heavy' lock) because it is a full-workspace lint pass, not because it touches a shared resource
svelte-check / tsc across every workspace package; a change in one package's exported types can break another's typecheck, which a path-scoped run would miss; serial for the same reason as lint above

real Postgres and Qdrant, same as ci.yml's gate job; serial because it binds fixed host ports (15432, 16333) -- named 'postgres' so it queues only behind other Postgres-bound checks on this box, not every heavy one

builds and boots the real runtime image against Postgres (SPEC.md #12); serial because it binds Postgres's 15432 and the app's own 5196, and shares the 'postgres' lock with the test check above so the two never fight over 15432 either
